subject: How do i Retrieve Percentage methylation for just differentially methylayed CpGs

messages.author: b6b01260b5a0a310
messages.subject: How do i Retrieve Percentage methylation for just differentially methylayed CpGs
parts:
Hi all,
I recently started using methylkit to analyze my RRBS data. I have difficulty retrieving only the percentage methylation for differentially methylated CpGs, as the percMethyaltio function does not work with methylDiff objects.
I tried using as to coerce the methylDiff object into a methylRaw object but it isn't working.
could anyone help me out please?

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] How do i Retrieve Percentage methylation for just differentially methylayed CpGs
parts:
Hi,

You could convert the significant methylDiff ranges into a Granges object, then use selectByOverlap to filter the original methylBase object based on them and finally run percMethylation on the filtered methylBase object.

It should be possible to run this via pipes, here is some pseudocode (not tested):

methylBase |> 
  selectByOverlap(
    ranges = methylDiff |> 
      getMethylDiff() |> 
      GRanges() ) |> 
  percMethylation()


Best
Alex
